description: Add sibling unit tests for the 7 server services that still lack them (ReleaseParserProvider closed separately by bug_ai_release_parser_lockdown_20260728), closing the last verified server-service coverage gap using TDD.
deviation_notes: Addresses tech-debt item (2026-07-26). Spec said 8 services; re-verified against source 2026-07-28 and corrected to 7 — ReleaseParserProvider now has a 73-test sibling suite from the parser track, and is 266 LOC not the 63 the spec records. The other 7 confirmed to exist with no sibling test, but measured coverage shows 'no sibling test' != 'untested': DataDirectoryInitializer is already at 90% branch and WantedService reports 100% only because it has zero branches.
